AllowMultipleHint: A screen that uses this list may let the user pick more than one value.
AmountRequired: Enter an amount of zero or more.
CashNameHint: A name containing "cash" makes the till work out change. "Customer Debt" is reserved for sales put on a customer's account.
CodeListNotFound: That code list no longer exists.
CodeListsNote: Named sets of values that other screens can offer as choices. Nothing in the app reads them yet.
ConverterHint: Shows what the till would show: the amount goes through US dollars and is rounded to 2 decimals. Nothing is changed.
CurrencyActiveHint: An inactive currency is not offered for new prices or payments.
CurrencyCodeHint: Short code such as USD or LBP.
CurrencySymbolHint: Printed next to amounts, e.g. $ or ل.ل
DatesOrder: The end date can't be before the start date.
DeactivateTaxConfirm: Deactivate this tax? It stops applying today.
DefaultCurrencyHint: The till opens in this currency. The previous default stops being the default.
DefaultDiscountHint: Preselected at the till. The previous default stops being the default.
DefaultPaymentMethodHint: Preselected at the till. The previous default stops being the default.
DefaultStaysHint: This is the default currency. To change it, make another currency the default.
DefaultTaxHint: Used when a calculation names no tax. The previous default stops being the default.
DeleteCodeListConfirm: Delete this code list and all its values? This cannot be undone.
DeleteCurrencyConfirm: Delete this currency? This cannot be undone.
DeleteDiscountConfirm: Delete this discount? This cannot be undone.
DeletePaymentMethodConfirm: Delete this payment method? This cannot be undone.
DeleteRateConfirm: Delete this exchange rate? Prices fall back to the US-dollar rates of the currencies.
DeleteTaxConfirm: Delete this tax? This cannot be undone.
DeleteValueConfirm: Delete this value? This cannot be undone.
EffectiveFromHint: Leave empty for no start date.
EffectiveToHint: The tax applies through the end of this day. Leave empty for no end date.
ExchangeRateHelp: One unit of the first currency is worth this many units of the second. The opposite direction is a separate rate.
ExchangeRatesNote: A rate here overrides the US-dollar rates of the currencies when cart and product prices are converted. The till's own price conversion uses the currencies' rates.
ListKeyHint: Unique; how other screens look the list up.
MetadataHint: Free-form data a screen using the list may read.
NoCodeListsMatch: No code list matches your search
NoPaymentMethodsMatch: No payment method matches your search
NoRatesMatch: No exchange rate matches your search
NoRatesMessage: Without a pair rate, prices convert through the US-dollar rate of each currency.
NoValues: This list has no values yet.
OrderRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100000.
PaymentMethodNotFound: That payment method no longer exists.
PaymentMethodsNote: "Customer Debt" is the system method behind "add to customer account": it is listed here but cannot be changed or deleted.
RateChangeWarning: A new rate changes every price shown in this currency from now on. Receipts already issued keep their amounts.
RateHint: How many units of the second currency one unit of the first is worth.
RateNotFound: That exchange rate no longer exists.
RatePositive: Enter a rate greater than zero.
RateToUsdHint: How many units of this currency one US dollar buys (the dollar itself is 1).
SupplierRateHint: Leave empty for the store-wide rate. A supplier's rate applies to that supplier's products only.
TaxInclusiveHint: Turn on when the prices you enter already contain the tax.
TaxNote: Tax rates are kept here for reference and reports. The till does not add tax to sales yet.
